data.title: A2 · 林间的旧机器
data.description: 生锈的机械残骸半埋在森林里。A2 蹲下观察它的外壳，手指停在裂开的接缝旁。
data.promptProse: Deep within an overgrown woodland clearing in her weathered grey hooded cloak and dark trousers, A2 crouches beside the moss-covered, rusted shell of a half-buried machine lifeform. Leaning in cautiously with narrowed focus, she hovers her fingers just beside a split metal seam in the decaying chassis without letting her guard drop. Dappled afternoon sunlight filters through the dense forest canopy, speckling her grey cloak and the rusted iron plates.
data.animaCaption: Crouched beside a moss-covered, rusted machine wreck in her grey hooded cloak, A2 studies its split metal seam with one hand poised cautiously nearby. Dappled afternoon sunlight filters through the forest canopy onto the weathered shell.
